reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin for customizing themes, gradient or local-image backgrounds, frosted-glass styling, and animated ambient lighting with saved settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供主题、渐变或本地图片背景、毛玻璃效果和流动氛围灯等外观定制功能。
summaries.en: Customizes the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with selectable themes, gradient or local-image backgrounds, frosted-glass styling, and animated ambient lighting.

capabilities: Changes Web UI themes, backgrounds, transparency, and visual effects
Accepts local image uploads for use as backgrounds
Persists user appearance settings across refreshes and restarts
